buildCommand: node scripts/check-env.mjs && prisma generate && next build

crons.comment: G10 — drain the AiJob queue every 5 minutes so queued jobs (ENGINE_RUN, PROPOSAL_GENERATION, AI_REMATCH, EVALUATOR_SIM, COPILOT_DEEP_ANALYSIS, PROFILE_FACT_EXTRACTION) run even when the user has closed the browser. The worker uses Vercel's built-in cron auth via the user-agent + AI_JOBS_WORKER_SECRET header set via Vercel env vars. Each tick claims ONE job and exits, so the 60s Vercel function budget is never exceeded.
